messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 12):
"""
(7) Put in place end to end technology solutions so as to ensure an effective, efficient and a seamless onboarding of policyholders, renewal of policy, policy servicing, grievance redressal and claim settlement process. II. In order to provide cashless claim settlement from the date of commencement of cover, the Insurer shall obtain the details of members of the group from the master policyholder, at the earliest. No claim shall be denied for non-availability of details of members of the group. III. Combi Product: Insurers may offer Health Plus Life Combi products. IV. Insurers along with the Insurance Councils may endeavor to - a. Have in place common empanelment of hospitals/healthcare providers, so that cashless facility can be availed anywhere; b. Provide seamless journey to the policyholder at each point of sale, service and claim; c.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What must an insurer do to ensure cashless claim settlement from the start of coverage for a group policy?","answer":"The insurer must obtain the details of all members of the group from the master policyholder at the earliest, and no claim will be denied for lack of those details.","facts":["Insurer shall obtain the details of members of the group from the master policyholder, at the earliest","No claim shall be denied for non-availability of details of members of the group"]},{"question":"What are the steps insurers and insurance councils should take to provide a seamless cashless facility?","answer":"They should establish common empanelment of hospitals so cashless service is available anywhere, and ensure a seamless journey for the policyholder at every point of sale, service and claim.","facts":["Have in place common empanelment of hospitals/healthcare providers, so that cashless facility can be availed anywhere","Provide seamless journey to the policyholder at each point of sale, service and claim"]}]}
